# Accenture Solutions Private Limited

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **partial** · Budget spent: statutory CSR-2/annexure spend figures were not locatable via readable public sources; several strong candidate sources (Scribd, Tracxn, LinkedIn, CSRBOX, Dataful) were held/refused. Program and partner data was well covered via Accenture's own India CSR Policy document.

Confirmed the correct Section 135 entity as Accenture Solutions Private Limited (CIN U72400MH1990PTC057492, ROC Mumbai, incorporated 1990), the Indian subsidiary that files CSR under the Companies Act 2013 -- distinct from the global parent Accenture plc. Accenture's own 'CSR Policy India' PDF (copyright 2024) names two CSR themes (Livelihood Enhancement through Skilling / 'Skills to Succeed', and Environmental Stewardship) and lists 37 named CSR projects run through 31 distinct implementing NGO/foundation partners with their CSR-1 registration numbers, including recurring partners Sambhav Foundation (4 projects), Dr. Reddy's Foundation (2), Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India (2) and Efficient Ecosystem Protection Association/Farmers for Forests (2). Two projects (EDII and Dr Reddy's Foundation) are located in Nirmal district but the source does not name the state, so no footprint record was created to avoid inferring a location. Separately, Accenture co-runs the Future Right Skills Network (FRSN), a public-private skilling alliance with Quest Alliance and Cisco in partnership with India's Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship, launched 2019, working with ITIs nationwide; quantified outcome metrics were shown only as icon captions with no numeric values in the extractable text, so no metric records were saved. No CSR-2 filing amounts, prescribed CSR, total spend, or year-by-year spend/footprint figures were found in readable sources for FY2023-24, FY2022-23 or FY2021-22 -- this is the principal gap.

Website: https://www.accenture.com

## What it set out to find

- identity: legal name, funder_type, section_135_bound, website
- identifier: CIN, PAN, domain
- csr_year: FY2023-24, FY2022-23, FY2021-22 -- section_135_applicable, prescribed_csr, spent_on_projects, total_spent, impact_assessment_done
- csr_spend: by project/aggregate with sector, state, district, implementing agency, amount
- footprint: state/district actually funded
- stated_geography: priority states separate from footprint
- partner: named NGOs/universities/govt partners by year, canonical name, kind
- program: Skills to Succeed and related themes/programmes
- metric: beneficiaries/outcomes with stage and method
- contact: public CSR roles
- document: CSR policy, annual report, CSR annexure
